facts.text: Fluent is a SiLA2 client wrapper: it builds a SilaClient unless one is passed, and refuses a server without the SilaFluentController feature
start_fluent() with no credentials calls StartFluentOrAttach; simulation_mode calls StartFluentInSimulationMode; a username and password call StartFluentAndLogin
prepare_method() calls PrepareMethod and run_method() calls RunMethod on the SilaFluentController
pause_run(), resume_run() and stop_method() call PauseRun, ResumeRun and StopMethod on the SilaFluentController
The stop_method docstring says it stops a method run and recommends finish_execution() for a soft stop
StopMethod is an unobservable command without parameters, described as 'Stops the method'
The server's StopMethod handler calls the implementation's StopMethod and returns an empty response; it has no try/catch
The C# StopMethod calls AssertRuntime() and then _runtime.StopMethod()
AssertRuntime throws InvalidOperationException while no runtime exists ('This may be because FluentControl has not been started')
CreateRuntimeAndRegisterEvents takes the runtime from the FluentControl process and registers the ChannelOpens, ModeChanged, ProgressChanged and Error handlers
The connector's State starts as FluentControlState.Unknown and its Progress as -1
Runtime_ModeChanged sets State by casting the runtime's StateMachineStates value to FluentControlState
The status provider's GetState returns the implementation's State property
The status provider declares State (FluentControlState), Progress (Integer) and LastError (String) as observable properties
FluentControlState is a String constrained to a set of named states, among them EditMode, RunModeRunning, RunModePaused, RunModeStopOnError, RunModeRunFinished and Unknown
FluentControlState documents EditMode as 'Application is in edit mode'
FluentControlState documents RunModeRunFinished as 'Run mode is active; Run is finished or aborted'
Aspirate and Dispense take an integer volume, a labware name, a liquid-class name and an integer well offset
The Aspirate command class takes only a volume, a labware, a liquid class and a well offset
Aspirate's generated script writes the same volume into each of its eight Volumes entries
Aspirate's generated script fixes SelectedWellsString '8 * A1' and selected tip indexes 0 to 7, and inserts the WellOffset
Aspirate's generated script names the device alias Instrument=1/Device=LIHA:1 and the fixed device ID USB:TECAN,MYRIUS,1310005667/LIHA:1
The Dispense command class takes only a volume, a labware, a liquid class and a well offset
Dispense's generated script writes the same volume into each of its eight Volumes entries
Dispense's generated script fixes SelectedWellsString 'A1 - H1' and selected tip indexes 0 to 7, and inserts the WellOffset
Dispense's generated script names the device alias Instrument=1/Device=LIHA:1 and the fixed device ID USB:TECAN,MYRIUS,1310005667/LIHA:1
DropTips' generated script names the device alias Instrument=1/Device=LIHA:1 and the fixed device ID USB:TECAN,MYRIUS,1310005667/LIHA:1
PrepareMethod runs 'cmd.exe /c rd' against the Journaling/000 and Journaling/ToDelete directories before _runtime.PrepareMethod
get_all_runnable_methods returns GetAllRunnableMethods().ReturnValue; its docstring says it can only show methods that are visible in touchtools
get_variable_names only works if a method is prepared but not yet running
set_variable_value sends the variable name and the string form of the value to SetVariableValue
TriggerCommand executes a command only when the current execution channel exists and IsAlive; otherwise it throws NoExecutionChannelException
StartFluentOrAttach waits on _waitForRuntimeIsReady.Wait() with no timeout when FluentControl was not already running
PrepareMethodRun waits on _waitForEditMode.Wait() with no timeout unless the runtime reports EditMode, then calls _runtime.PrepareMethod('Method to prepare')
set_location, transfer_labware and transfer_labware_back_to_base call the same-named SilaFluentController commands
drop_tips calls DropTips on the SilaFluentController
The SiLA SimulationController reports SimulationMode false and its StartSimulationMode throws
The README says to install the server with the Windows installer in the Binaries folder and then start SilaFluentServer.exe

safe_state.description: After StopMethod returned, the connector's State reads RunModeRunFinished (documented as finished or aborted) or EditMode within 0.4 s, else SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held; State caches FluentControl mode-change events (not a fresh query), StopMethod's effect on an API command in flight is not in the clone, and FluentControl and the instrument stay powered with tips, liquid and labware where the stop left them.
